name: codenote
description: Write visual Markdown notes inside real source files, study them by section, review concepts, export PDF, and create aesthetic code snapshots.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Notes that live with your code.
[Insert Note](command:codenote.insertNote)
[Find Notes](command:codenote.searchWorkspace)
[Review Due](command:codenote.startReview)

codenote.liveVisualMode.description: Render completed .cnote blocks visually whenever the caret is outside them. Enter a note to edit the real source.

codenote.inlineKindHints.description: Show small semantic labels such as Warning or Quiz in automatic inline visual notes.

codenote.inlineShowTags.description: Show note tags in automatic inline visual notes.

codenote.inlineRenderDelay.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for automatic inline rendering after caret movement.

codenote.workspaceIndexMaxFiles.description: Maximum source files .cnote scans when building the workspace note index.

codenote.cppStandard.description: C++ standard used by the optional Run Current File command.

codenote.runCommands.description: Optional custom run commands keyed by VS Code language id.

codenote.snap.defaultTemplate.description: Default visual template for .cnote Snap Studio.

codenote.snap.lineNumbers.description: Show line numbers by default in code snapshots.

codenote.snap.branding.description: Show a small .cnote mark on exported snapshots.

codenote.snap.maxLines.description: Maximum lines captured by Snap Studio when no selection is active.

codenote.inlineBoundaryStyle.description: Visual marker used on source comment opener and closer rows so inline visual mode preserves the exact physical line count.

codenote.inlineBoundarySymbol.description: Custom symbol shown at the start and end of an inline visual note when boundary style is Symbol.

codenote.inlineBoundaryLabel.description: Show the note type beside the opening inline boundary marker.

codenote.shortcut.noteTrigger.description: Text typed at the start of a line followed by Space to create a one-line .cnote note.

codenote.shortcut.headingTrigger.description: Text typed at the start of a line followed by Space to create a one-line .cnote heading.

codenote.shortcut.paragraphTrigger.description: Text typed at the start of a line followed by Space to create a .cnote definition block.

codenote.study.defaultFocusNotes.description: Open Study with Focus Notes enabled by default.

codenote.study.showSidebar.description: Show the section navigation sidebar in Study.

codenote.study.lineNumbers.description: Show source line numbers inside Study code blocks.
